title: Blog
description: An Article post-type, a /blog folder and three published sample posts. The starting point for anything with a feed: the model is the part that is tedious to get right, and the samples show the field usage a later session should match.
author: Viglet

title: Documentation

author: Viglet

title: Landing page
description: One campaign page at /get-started, composed of a hero, a feature grid, an FAQ and a call to action from the @viglet/shio-sections vocabulary. The smallest useful blueprint: apply it, edit four sections, ship.
author: Viglet

title: Marketing site
description: A three-page marketing site built from the @viglet/shio-sections vocabulary: home, pricing and about, each composed of known sections (hero, feature grid, logo wall, testimonials, FAQ, call to action). The React components that render these sections ship in @viglet/shio-sections, so the front end is a dependency rather than a rewrite.
author: Viglet

title: Next.js starter
description: The first-party starter, whole: a Page model, two published pages, and the Next.js App Router project that renders them — catch-all routing, ISR, draft preview, signed revalidation. Same tree as `npm create shio-app`, with the content.
author: Viglet
